title: STAMP: Symmetric Temporal Averaging Message Passing for Domain Adaptation in Chronologically Split Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2411.10957v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This paper addresses domain adaptation in graph-structured data under chronological splits. We consider transductive semi-supervised node classification (SSNC), in which labels of historical nodes are used to predict labels of more recent nodes. Temporal dependencies in graph connectivity induce distribution shifts across time, often degrading the performance of models trained on past nodes. Despite its practical relevance, domain adaptation under chronological graph splits remains relatively underexplored. We propose Symmetric Temporal Averaging Message Passing (STAMP), a timestamp-balanced operator that replaces standard neighborhood aggregation with temporally aligned propagation. We call its specialized variant for the heterogeneous ogbn-mag dataset STAMP-mag, reserving STAMP for the general formulation. translated_title: STAMP：用于按时间顺序划分图域自适应的对称时间平均消息传递
translated_abstract: 本文研究按时间顺序划分下图结构数据中的域自适应问题。我们考虑直推式半监督节点分类（SSNC），即利用历史节点的标签来预测较新节点的标签。图连通性中的时间依赖性会引起跨时间的分布偏移，这往往会降低在历史节点上训练的模型的性能。尽管具有重要的实际意义，但按时间顺序划分图下的域自适应问题仍然相对未被充分探索。我们提出对称时间平均消息传递（STAMP），这是一种时间戳平衡算子，用时间对齐的传播取代标准的邻域聚合。我们将其针对异质 ogbn-mag 数据集的专门变体称为 STAMP-mag，而将 STAMP 保留用于一般形式。通过在时间戳之间平衡消息，STAMP 在时间域之间强制实现一阶矩不变性，同时保持……
tldr: 提出对称时间平均消息传递（STAMP），通过在时间戳间平衡消息强制时间域间的一阶矩不变性，从而解决按时间顺序划分图中的分布偏移问题，提升半监督节点分类性能。
en_tdlr: STAMP, a symmetric temporal averaging message passing operator that enforces first-moment invariance across temporal domains by balancing messages across timestamps, addressing domain adaptation in chronologically split graphs for semi-supervised node classification.
